name: Loyalist Exploration Limited
summary: Loyalist Exploration Limited operates as a mineral exploration entity, primarily engaged in identifying, acquiring, and advancing mineral properties within Papua New Guinea. The company's core focus is on discovering copper and gold reserves. It possesses an exclusive option to secure an 85% ownership share in the Mount Suckling project, an initiative comprising two distinct mineral concessions situated in Papua New Guinea. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Timmins, Canada, the firm was formerly known as Golden Birch Resources Inc. until it adopted the name PNG Copper Inc. in August 2021.
